entries.speaker: Thin Businessman
entries.en: This isn't how it was supposed to be...[n]It's all society's fault for not accepting me...

entries.speaker: Thin Businessman
entries.en: Hard work only brings exhaustion...[n]This life is such a waste...

entries.speaker: Thin Businessman
entries.en: Yes... I wish everything would just end[n]already...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell is he talkin' about, "end"!?[n]This is bullshit!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Goddammit... Who the hell's lockin' all[n]these people up?

entries.speaker: Listless Youth
entries.en: There's nothing I can do myself... I'll just[n]leave social reform to someone else who[n]has the power...

entries.speaker: Listless Youth
entries.en: I'm not fit for that kinda stuff... Anyway,[n]the world's gonna end soon so... who[n]really cares?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The world's going to end?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What does he mean by that? It's more[n]than just some offhand comment, right?

entries.speaker: Dour Young Man
entries.en: Social reform? I'm not interested.[n]That stuff's lame anyway. Don't you[n]think destruction's more pleasing?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Destruction is... pleasing? He cannot be[n]in his right mind.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It is as though he wishes for the world[n]to end...

entries.speaker: Wry-Smiling Woman
entries.en: Are you guys escaped convicts? Hahaha...[n]Maybe you should stop trying so hard to[n]get out...

entries.speaker: Wry-Smiling Woman
entries.en: I heard there were some others who[n]escaped this place, but they found their[n]way back recently...

entries.speaker: Wry-Smiling Woman
entries.en: Wouldn't it be better if people just lived[n]with the hand they've been dealt? How[n]hilarious...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is she talkin' about Kamoshida and all[n]the others?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno how to put this... It's almost like[n]our targets were still more human than[n]all these people in here...

entries.speaker: Dull-Eyed Young Man
entries.en: The outside world? I can see it all online.[n]It'd be a pain actually going anywhere...

entries.speaker: Dull-Eyed Young Man
entries.en: And besides... it's going to be happening[n]soon...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So he just wants to see the world from[n]online, huh?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I know how that might feel, but it gets old[n]after a while. I can speak from experience...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And besides that, what's "happening[n]soon"?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is it... The place where I was born...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: H-Here? The hell is it!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I don't know... I can't remember[n]anything more...

entries.speaker: Someone's Yell
entries.en: Hey! Get away from that!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hmph, what foul timing... Let us[n]defeat it before it attempts to enlist[n]reinforcements!
